rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a job or activity that occupies the person’s full working time.

example.english: I'm working as a full-time nurse now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 cyun4 zik1 wu6 si6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice when saying someone works full-time.

example.english: I work full-time as a designer now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 cyun4 zik1 zou6 cit3 gai3
